In the management of [[ibd|IBD]] (Inflammatory Bowel Disease), clinical consensus establishes the standard medical agreements for handling disease complications and treatment side effects. A primary area of agreement highlighted in the corpus concerns bone health during corticosteroid therapy. There is a general clinical consensus that osteoporosis caused by steroid treatment can be effectively prevented [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence for this specific topic is limited to a single assertion, further details regarding specific preventative protocols, screening guidelines, or additional areas of clinical consensus are not available in the current data.

## Claims
- Der er generelt enighed om, at osteoporose ved steroidbehandling kan forebygges [^src1] (ibd)
